name: guard: the repo-root lanes/ root is taken back out
guard: the mutat-in-the-filename narrowing comes back
guard: the git-checkout pattern stops being an offence
driver: run-browser-arm.sh goes back to restoring from git
from:
cleanup () {
  if [ -n "${DEV_PID:-}" ]; then
    kill "${DEV_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "${DEV_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  # The file as it stood when this script started — clean tree, dirty tree or neither.
  if [ -f "${ORIGINAL}" ]; then
    cp "${ORIGINAL}" "${TARGET}"
    rm -f "${ORIGINAL}"
  fi
}
to:
cleanup () {
  if [ -n "${DEV_PID:-}" ]; then
    kill "${DEV_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "${DEV_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  git checkout -- "${TARGET}" 2>/dev/null || true
}
